d: We are currently seeking passionate and dynamic IT professionals who pride themselves on their ability to deliver extraordinary levels of customer service and provide creative solutions to our guests.
q: You should ideally have a degree in Information Technology and previous experience in a similar role, along with proven knowledge of the operation and maintenance of IT equipment and systems.
A good command of English is essential, together with the ability to troubleshoot, identify faults, and rectify system or subsystem issues.

The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, hands-on, proactive, reliable, and flexible, with the ability to adapt to unpredictable situations. You should be comfortable working in a busy environment, remain calm under pressure, and demonstrate strong attention to detail.
